qa_method: Article-by-article review of the P0-003 internal Chinese reference translations against the official Arabic governing text, using the official English only as secondary guidance. Checks: legal-meaning preservation, terminology, entity/authority roles, obligations/rights, conditions/exceptions/deadlines, and scope boundaries. Review only — no Chinese text or remediation data was modified. Hashes only; no full Arabic/English/Chinese text embedded.
